changeSet.author: rtcomops
changeSet.comment: Add cashed_date column to track when deposit funds were received
changeSet.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN treasury.check_deposits.cashed_date IS 'Date when the deposit was cashed/funds received in account';

changeSet.author: rtcomops
changeSet.comment: Update status constraint to support full workflow: PENDING -> DEPOSITED -> CASHED (+ RECONCILED)
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE treasury.check_deposits DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_check_deposits_status;

COMMENT ON COLUMN treasury.check_deposits.status IS 'Workflow status: PENDING = created, awaiting bank deposit; DEPOSITED = deposited at bank; CASHED = funds received; RECONCILED = matched with bank statement';

changeSet.author: rtcomops
changeSet.comment: Change default status from DEPOSITED to PENDING

changeSet.author: rtcomops
changeSet.comment: Existing records with DEPOSITED status remain DEPOSITED (they were created with the old workflow and are already confirmed at bank). This changeset is informational - no data migration needed.
